prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit image1, our five-phase transparent deer head atlas, preserving its painted identity, five phase order, all right-facing profiles, cocoa fur, ivory muzzle, amber eyes, lavender-apricot crystal antlers, indigo scarf and warm gold charm. Image2 is the source STRUCTURAL phase guide only (phases0,1,2,4,5). Images3 and4 are established painted Daoist Q style. Image5 is original identity head reference.
Critical measured correction: image1's five head alpha bounds are approximately324px wide by427px tall, visibly TOO TALL/NARROW. Redraw anatomy/accessories to a compact head silhouette approximately340px wide by370px tall, W/H0.913 matching21:23. Do NOT merely scale or stretch the existing artwork. Shorten the crystal antlers substantially (about35% lower rise) while retaining branching and lavender/apricot crystal design, shorten the scarf lower edge/charm drop by about30%, broaden the rounded cheek and visible ear modestly. Preserve head-only, no body. Each occupied silhouette must have W/H0.89–0.94. Keep full horns and scarf inside alpha boundary.
Output genuinely transparent1536x1024, same exact3x2 cells512square. Five isolated heads in cells rowmajor[0,1,2,4,5], bottomright empty. All face screenRIGHT; same fixed scale, centred in each cell, generous transparent margin. Phases0/1/2 open eye/muzzle subtle highlight variation;4/5 slightly narrower nose/muzzle as source. Do not bake source vertical offset into drawings. Preserve fine HD handpainting and coherent identity. No background, shadows, glow clouds, floor, labels, watermark, text, checkerboard or additional objects.
